text.tspan: Do not use pints GPIO0. GPIO1 GPIO14, GPIO15, ,
GPIO 0 (Pin 27) and GPIO 1 (Pin 28): These are reserved for ID EEPROM communication.
GPIO 2 (Pin 3) and GPIO 3 (Pin 5): These pins have physical 1.8kΩ pull-up resistors soldered to the board for I2C communication.
UART (Serial): GPIO 14 (TX) and GPIO 15 (RX) are reserved for serial console communication by default
1-Wire: GPIO 4 is the default pin for 1-Wire sensors (like the DS18B20); if enabled, it will not behave as a standard toggleable pin.
SPI: GPIO 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11 are reserved for the SPI bus when enabled.
